verdict.rationale: GitBook documents publishing to a custom domain: the pricing page lists 'Use a custom domain', and a dedicated docs page explains that you can set a custom domain so your audience reaches your documentation there. That satisfies the 'own custom domain' branch of the story. missing for 10: any evidence of serving docs as a /docs subpath of an existing main site, setup details such as DNS/SSL configuration and plan requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
